lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like topology across the mid-flank posterior to the branchial region. Spacing exhibits roughly uniform vertical and horizontal intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating nodes of maximum luminance at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the upper two-thirds of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with luminance highlights on the dorsal aspect and shadowing on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, with lower spatial density compared to the adjacent lateral flank areas.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral surface, with the most prominent individual located posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
